The series is back!

It’s been over six years since Part 1 first dropped (way back in 2019!). The author’s art has leveled up big time since then, and the best part? This new release stands totally on its own--no need to catch up on the old stuff if you don’t want to.

But if you’re curious about where it all began, you can still check out Part 1 here: https://e-hentai.org/g/1510491/af9198cdfb/

Quick update: Things are moving fast! Part 3 (the direct follow-up to this one) is already translated and in typesetting. I’ll get it to you as soon as humanly possible.

Dive in and enjoy!
